title: Async subprocess started through a shell in python — review required
description: asyncio.create_subprocess_shell always runs its command through the shell. A value interpolated into the command string is parsed as shell syntax, so a semicolon or backtick appends commands. The rule flags the API; the exec variant is the argument-vector counterpart.
remediation: Use asyncio.create_subprocess_exec with separate arguments and validate dynamic values.
limitation: Lexical: matches create_subprocess_shell calls; the exec variant is not reported.
